naam: Hamstring rekken – staand met hiel vooruit
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A plain chair stands beside her and her left hand rests lightly on its backrest. Her RIGHT foot is placed half a step forward, resting ONLY on the heel with the toes pointing up toward the ceiling and the right knee completely straight. Her left (back) leg carries the weight with the knee slightly bent. Her back is straight and her torso is still upright. The arrow is a curved arrow starting at her upper back and going FORWARD and DOWN over her right leg, showing the straight-backed torso tipping forward from the hips while the hips move backward.
eind_en: END position: same side view, same feet: the right heel still forward on the floor with the toes up and the right knee straight, the left knee slightly bent. Her buttocks have moved BACKWARD and her torso, with a long straight back (NOT rounded), is tipped forward from the hips about 45 degrees over the straight right leg. Her left hand still rests on the chair backrest.
extra_avatar: Seen from her RIGHT side so the straight right leg with the toes pulled up is clearly visible. TOP: upright. BOTTOM: hips pushed back and the straight back tipped forward over the right leg - the back stays flat, she does not reach for her toes.

naam: Knie buigen – zittend met hulp van het andere been
pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. Her right knee is bent a little more than a right angle and her right foot rests on its toes slightly BEHIND the front edge of the seat, under the chair. Her LEFT leg crosses in FRONT of the right lower leg: the left ankle is hooked against the FRONT of the right shin, just above the right ankle. Her hands rest on her thighs. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the right foot pointing BACKWARD (toward the viewer's left), under the chair, showing the left leg pushing the right foot further back.
eind_en: END position: same side view on the same chair. The left ankle, still hooked in front of the right shin, has pushed the right foot clearly further BACKWARD under the chair, so the right knee is bent much more sharply (well past a right angle). Hands still on the thighs, back upright.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the waist down to the feet plus the chair, seen from her RIGHT side, so the two crossed lower legs and the right foot under the chair are large and clearly visible. Make the difference obvious: TOP the right foot just behind the front edge of the seat, BOTTOM the right foot far back under the chair.

naam: Been heffen met voet naar buiten – half liggend op de ellebogen
pose_en: She half-lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, propped up on BOTH ELBOWS (forearms flat on the mat beside her body, upper body raised about 30 degrees), seen in a THREE-QUARTER view from her feet and her right side, so both legs are clearly visible. Her LEFT knee is bent with the left foot flat on the mat. Her RIGHT leg lies straight on the mat and is clearly turned OUTWARD from the hip: the right kneecap and the toes point diagonally OUT to the right side, not up. The arrow is a straight arrow next to the right ankle pointing UP, showing the straight, outward-turned right leg being lifted.
eind_en: END position: same view and same position on the elbows. The straight right leg is lifted off the mat until the right heel is at about the height of the bent left knee. The right leg is still turned OUTWARD: kneecap and toes still point diagonally out to the right. The left foot stays flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Three-quarter view from her feet and right side. In BOTH figures the right leg is visibly rotated outward (toes pointing out to the side, not to the ceiling). TOP: right leg flat on the mat. BOTTOM: right leg lifted straight to the height of the left knee.

naam: Knie strekken tegen een bal – langzit
pose_en: Close-up framing: show her from the hips down to the wall, large in the frame. She sits on the floor with straight back, hands on the floor beside her hips, legs in front of her, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), and a wall is on the viewer's right. Her left leg lies straight on the floor. Her RIGHT knee is clearly BENT (about 30 degrees, the knee lifted a hand's width off the floor) and the sole of her right foot presses against a small round ball (about the size of a grapefruit) that sits on the floor against the wall. Her right kneecap points up to the ceiling. The arrow is a short straight arrow at the right heel pointing toward the wall, showing the heel pushing into the ball.
eind_en: END position: same close-up side view. The right knee is now almost STRAIGHT and lies nearly flat, the heel pressing the small ball firmly against the wall so the ball looks slightly squashed. The muscle on the front of her right thigh is visibly tensed. Left leg unchanged.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing of the right leg from the hip to the foot, seen from the side. TOP: the right knee is clearly BENT (about 30 degrees, knee lifted off the floor) with the sole against the ball at the wall. BOTTOM: the right knee is fully STRAIGHT, the back of the knee pressed flat to the floor, pushing the ball into the wall. The difference in knee angle must be obvious.

naam: Hoppen in vier richtingen – op één been
pose_en: She stands on her RIGHT leg only, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). The right knee is slightly bent, her left foot is lifted just off the floor behind her with the left knee bent, arms slightly bent beside her body for balance. The arrow is a curved arc starting at her right foot and going UP and FORWARD (toward the viewer's right) and down again, showing a small hop forward on the same leg.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She has landed softly a short distance further FORWARD on the same RIGHT leg, the right knee bent over the foot to absorb the landing, the left foot still off the floor, arms out slightly for balance.
extra_avatar: Place the BOTTOM figure clearly further to the viewer's right than the TOP figure, to show the hop forward. In both figures she stands on the RIGHT leg only and the left foot never touches the floor.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left. Both knees are bent, both feet flat on the mat at hip width, arms straight beside her body with the palms down. The arrow is a curved arrow starting under her buttocks and going UP, showing the hips being lifted.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her hips are lifted so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, AND both heels are lifted high off the mat so she stands only on the balls of her feet and toes. Shoulders and arms stay on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. In the BOTTOM figure the heels must be clearly and visibly lifted high off the mat (on tiptoe), in addition to the hips being up. In the TOP figure the feet are flat.

pose_en: She stands upright on her RIGHT leg only, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view so her face is clearly visible. Her left knee is bent and the left foot is lifted off the floor behind her, about a hand's width high. Her arms are held slightly out to the sides for balance. Her EYES ARE CLEARLY CLOSED (drawn as two calm curved lines). A short straight arrow under the lifted left foot points UP.
eind_en: She holds this position: standing on the right leg only, left foot lifted behind her, arms slightly out to the sides, EYES CLOSED.
extra_avatar: Her face must be clearly visible with the eyes visibly CLOSED, calm expression. Three-quarter front view, full body, standing on the right leg only.

naam: Hiel tikken – ruglig met benen in de lucht
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left, head resting on the mat. Both legs are lifted with the hips and knees each bent at a RIGHT ANGLE (thighs vertical, lower legs horizontal, parallel to the floor, as if resting on an invisible low table). Her hands rest flat on her belly. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right heel going DOWN toward the mat, showing the right heel being lowered to tap the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right heel touches the mat, the right knee is still bent; the left leg stays up with hip and knee at right angles. Hands still on the belly, lower back flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. TOP: both lower legs horizontal in the air (tabletop). BOTTOM: only the right heel down on the mat, the left leg still in the air.

naam: Hamstring en kuit rekken – ruglig met band
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left, head on the mat. Her left leg lies straight on the mat. Her RIGHT leg is straight (knee fully extended) and raised to about 70 degrees. An exercise band loops around the ball of her right foot and both ends are held in her two hands, arms slightly bent, pulling the toes toward her. A short curved arrow at the toes of the right foot points toward her head, showing the foot being pulled toward her.
eind_en: She holds this stretch: lying on her back, left leg flat, right leg straight and raised, the band around the ball of the right foot pulling the toes toward her.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side so the band from the foot to both hands is clearly visible and the right knee is straight.

naam: Hoppen op de plaats – op één been
pose_en: She stands on her RIGHT leg only, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). The right knee is slightly bent, ready to jump; her left foot is lifted off the floor behind her with the left knee bent; arms slightly bent beside her body. The arrow is a straight arrow beside her right foot pointing straight UP, showing a small hop straight up on the same spot.
eind_en: END position: same side view, directly above the same spot. She is a few centimetres in the AIR: the right foot is just off the floor with the toes pointing slightly down, ready to land on the ball of the foot, the left foot still lifted behind her.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, framed from the hips down. TOP: standing on one leg with the knee slightly bent, foot flat on the floor. BOTTOM: the same foot clearly in the AIR, about 10 cm above the floor during the hop, the other leg still bent behind.

naam: Knie strekken – been op een stoel
pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). A second identical chair stands facing her. Her RIGHT leg is straight and only her right HEEL rests on the seat of the second chair, so there is a clear open space under the right knee (nothing supports the knee). Her left foot is flat on the floor. Her hands rest on her thighs. A short straight arrow just above the right kneecap points DOWN, showing the knee relaxing toward straight.
eind_en: She holds this position: sitting on one chair, right leg straight with only the heel on the second chair, the knee unsupported and relaxed, toes relaxed.
extra_avatar: Both chairs fully visible, seen from the side, with a clearly visible empty space under the right knee.

naam: Voorkant bovenbeen rekken – buiklig met band
pose_en: She lies on her STOMACH on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left, forehead resting on the mat. Her left leg lies straight. Her RIGHT knee is bent to about a right angle, the lower leg pointing up to the ceiling. An exercise band loops around her right ankle and runs over her right shoulder to both hands. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right foot going toward her buttocks, showing the band pulling the heel toward the buttocks.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The band, pulled by her hands over her shoulder, has brought the right heel close to her right buttock; the right knee is fully bent and stays on the mat. Left leg straight.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side so the band from the right ankle over the shoulder to the hands is clearly visible. TOP: lower leg vertical. BOTTOM: heel close to the buttock.

naam: Vooruit en achteruit springen – twee benen
pose_en: She stands with her feet side by side at hip width, knees slightly bent, arms swung slightly back ready to jump, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right). The arrow is a curved arc starting at her feet and going UP and FORWARD (toward the viewer's right) and down again, showing a small jump forward with both feet.
eind_en: END position: same side view. She has landed softly on both feet a short distance further FORWARD, on the balls of the feet, knees bent in a light squat, arms forward for balance.
extra_avatar: Place the BOTTOM figure clearly further to the viewer's right than the TOP figure, to show the jump forward. Both feet together in both figures.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left, head resting on the mat. Her left leg lies straight on the mat. Her RIGHT hip is bent to a right angle (thigh vertical) and both hands are clasped behind the back of the right thigh, holding it. The right knee is BENT so the right lower leg hangs roughly horizontal. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right foot going UP toward the ceiling, showing the right knee being straightened.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her hands still hold the right thigh vertical; the right knee is now nearly straight with the foot pointing up toward the ceiling. Head still on the mat, left leg flat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. The right thigh stays vertical in both figures, held by both hands; only the lower leg moves from horizontal (TOP) to pointing up (BOTTOM).

naam: Knie langzaam strekken – buiklig met hulp
pose_en: She lies on her STOMACH on an exercise mat, seen from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side, her head on the viewer's left, forehead on her folded hands. BOTH knees are bent, both lower legs pointing up, the right heel close to the buttock. Her LEFT ankle is hooked UNDER (in front of) the right ankle, supporting the right lower leg. The arrow is a long curved arrow at the right heel going BACKWARD and DOWN in an arc to the mat (toward the viewer's right), showing the right lower leg being lowered slowly on its own.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The left leg lies straight on the mat again. The right lower leg has been lowered slowly on its own and is now just above the mat, knee almost straight.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. TOP: both lower legs up with the left ankle hooked under the right ankle. BOTTOM: left leg flat, the right lower leg almost down, a small gap above the mat.

naam: Uitvalspas met elastiek opzij – knie recht houden
pose_en: She stands upright with her feet side by side, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view (her body turned about 45 degrees to the viewer's left). An elastic exercise band is tied to a sturdy post at knee height on her LEFT side; the band runs horizontally from the post to a loop around her RIGHT knee, pulled taut, so it pulls the right knee inward toward the left. Her hands rest on her hips. The arrow is a straight arrow at her right foot pointing FORWARD, showing a big step forward with the right leg.
eind_en: END position: same view. She is in a lunge with the right foot a big step forward: the right knee is bent about 90 degrees and stays straight above the right foot (it does NOT collapse inward), the left knee bent low behind her. The band is pulled taut from the post on her left to the right knee. Hands on the hips, upper body upright.
extra_avatar: Three-quarter front view so the band running sideways from the post to the right knee is clearly visible. In the BOTTOM figure the right knee points straight forward over the right foot despite the band pulling it sideways.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, arms beside her body. Her LEFT knee is bent with the left foot flat on the mat. Her RIGHT leg lies completely straight on the mat, toes pointing up. The arrow is a straight arrow next to the right ankle pointing UP, showing the straight right leg being lifted.
eind_en: END position: same side view, lying on her back. The right leg, knee completely STRAIGHT, is lifted off the mat until the right heel is at about the height of the bent left knee. The left foot stays flat on the mat, lower back on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: right leg flat on the mat. BOTTOM: the straight right leg lifted to the height of the bent left knee - the right knee stays completely straight.

pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. An elastic band is looped around the BACK of her right knee and runs horizontally FORWARD to an anchor on a table leg in front of her (on the viewer's right) at knee height. She stands with the RIGHT knee slightly BENT (about 25 degrees), pulled forward by the band, the right foot flat on the floor; the left leg is straight. The arrow is a short straight arrow at the back of the right knee pointing BACKWARD (to the viewer's left), showing the knee being straightened against the band.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The right knee is now pushed back until it is completely STRAIGHT, the elastic band stretched tight toward the anchor in front, the thigh muscle visibly tensed, the right foot still flat on the floor.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the hips down, seen from the side, band and anchor visible. TOP: right knee clearly bent, pulled forward by the band. BOTTOM: right knee fully straight, band taut. Exaggerate the difference in knee angle.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the hips down to the feet, large in the frame. She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. Her right leg lies stretched out but RELAXED: the knee is very slightly bent so there is a small gap between the back of the knee and the mat, the foot relaxed. The arrow is a short straight arrow at the top of the right knee pointing DOWN into the mat, showing the back of the knee being pressed down.
eind_en: END position: same close-up side view. The back of the right knee is pressed FLAT into the mat, the knee completely straight, the muscle on the front of the right thigh visibly tensed and bulging, the toes pulled up toward her and the heel lifting a fraction off the mat.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the hips down to the feet, seen from the side. Exaggerate the difference: TOP the leg relaxed with a visible gap under the knee and a relaxed foot; BOTTOM the knee pressed flat, thigh muscle clearly tensed, toes pulled up.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side (her body turned about 45 degrees), so both legs are clearly visible, feet hip-width apart, hands on her hips. A short loop of elastic band runs around BOTH thighs just above the knees. The arrow is a short straight arrow at her hips pointing DOWN, showing a small knee bend.
eind_en: END position: same view. Both knees are bent a SMALL amount (about 35 degrees), hips slightly back, back straight, the knees pointing straight over the feet and pressing lightly outward against the loop band, heels on the floor.
extra_avatar: Three-quarter front view, loop band just above the knees in both figures. TOP: standing straight. BOTTOM: a shallow squat - knees bent only about 35 degrees, knees above the feet (not falling inward), band taut.

pose_en: She lies on her LEFT SIDE on an exercise mat, seen from the FRONT (her face, chest and knees are toward the viewer), her head resting on her left arm. Hips and knees are bent (knees pulled forward, about 45 degrees at the hips and 90 degrees at the knees), the knees stacked on top of each other and the feet stacked on top of each other. The arrow is a curved arrow at the top (RIGHT) knee going UP, showing the top knee opening like a clamshell.
eind_en: END position: same view, still lying on her left side. The top (right) knee is lifted UP and open, pointing to the ceiling, while BOTH feet stay together and the hips stay stacked (the pelvis does not roll backward). The bottom leg stays on the mat.
extra_avatar: Side-lying, seen from the front. TOP: knees together. BOTTOM: the top knee opened high like a clamshell, feet still touching each other, hips stacked.

pose_en: She lies FACE DOWN (prone) on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her forehead resting on her folded hands, both legs straight on the mat. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right heel going UP and toward her buttocks, showing the right knee bending.
eind_en: END position: same side view, still lying face down. The right knee is bent well past a right angle so the right heel is close to her buttock; the right thigh stays flat on the mat. The left leg stays straight on the mat.
extra_avatar: Lying face down, seen from the side. TOP: both legs straight. BOTTOM: right knee bent far, heel toward the buttock, hips and thigh stay on the mat.

pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, arms beside her body, BOTH legs straight on the mat. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow along the mat at the right heel pointing toward her buttocks, showing the heel sliding over the mat so the knee bends.
eind_en: END position: same side view, lying on her back. The right heel has slid over the mat toward her buttock: the right knee is bent sharply and points to the ceiling, the right foot flat on the mat close to the buttock. The left leg stays straight on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: both legs straight. BOTTOM: right knee bent high, right foot on the mat near the buttock (the heel slid along the mat and never lifts). Left leg straight.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the hips down to the feet, large in the frame. She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A thick ROLLED-UP TOWEL lies under her RIGHT knee, so the right knee is bent about 30 degrees and the right heel rests on the mat. The left leg lies straight. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the right heel pointing UP, showing the heel lifting as the knee straightens.
eind_en: END position: same close-up side view. The back of the right knee still rests on the rolled towel, but the right knee is now completely STRAIGHT and the right heel is lifted clearly off the mat, toes pulled up, thigh muscle tensed.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the hips down, seen from the side, the rolled towel under the right knee clearly visible in both figures. TOP: knee bent over the towel, heel on the mat. BOTTOM: knee straight, heel lifted well off the mat, knee still on the towel.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, feet hip-width apart. A plain chair stands beside her on her LEFT side (on the viewer's right) and her left hand rests on its backrest for balance. A short loop of elastic band runs around BOTH ankles. The arrow is a curved arrow at her RIGHT ankle (on the viewer's left) going SIDEWAYS and outward, showing the straight right leg moving out to the side.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front. The straight RIGHT leg is lifted out to her right side (about 30 degrees), foot off the floor, toes pointing forward, the loop band stretched tight between the ankles. Her torso stays upright (not leaning), left hand on the chair.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front, loop band around both ankles. TOP: feet hip-width. BOTTOM: straight right leg out to the side, band taut, torso perfectly upright.

pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, both feet flat on the floor, knees bent at a right angle, hands on her thighs. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow at the right foot pointing BACKWARD (to the viewer's left), under the chair, showing the foot sliding back so the knee bends further.
eind_en: END position: same side view on the same chair. The right foot has slid far BACKWARD under the chair seat, so the right knee is bent much more sharply (well past a right angle), the foot resting on the ball of the foot. Left foot unchanged, back upright.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the waist down plus the chair, seen from the side. TOP: right foot flat under the knee. BOTTOM: right foot far back under the chair. Make the difference obvious.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A plain chair stands in front of her with its backrest toward her, and both hands rest lightly on the top of the backrest for balance. Both feet are on the floor, legs straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right heel going BACKWARD and UP toward her buttock, showing the right knee bending.
eind_en: END position: same side view. The right knee is bent to about a right angle so the right lower leg is horizontal and the heel points toward her buttock; the right thigh stays vertical next to the left thigh (the knee does not move forward). Torso upright, hands on the chair.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. TOP: both feet on the floor. BOTTOM: right knee bent 90 degrees or more, heel toward the buttock, both thighs side by side and vertical.

pose_en: She lies on her LEFT SIDE on an exercise mat, seen from the FRONT (her face, chest and knees are toward the viewer), her head resting on her left arm. Hips and knees are bent, the knees stacked and the feet stacked on top of each other. A short loop of elastic band runs around BOTH thighs just above the knees. The arrow is a curved arrow at the top (RIGHT) knee going UP, showing the top knee opening against the band.
eind_en: END position: same view, still lying on her left side. The top (right) knee is lifted UP and open while BOTH feet stay together; the loop band is stretched tight between the knees. Hips stay stacked.
extra_avatar: Side-lying, seen from the front, loop band just above the knees in both figures. TOP: knees together, band slack. BOTTOM: top knee opened high, band stretched, feet still touching.
